result.title: OCR in the Foundation Model Era: From Specialist Models to Unified Models
result.summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. This survey reviews its development, focusing on the Foundation Model Era. We define OCR through faithful transcription: within a specified visual scope, OCR should completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image, and every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image. We trace the development from specialist OCR models toward unified models, examining joint text detection and recognition, structured sequence generation, and the use of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We organize contemporary OCR systems into five coexisting families: modular toolkits and task-specific models, specialized document VLMs, hybrid workflows, general-purpose VLMs, and commercial products and managed services. We compare their architectures, data, and training, examining hallucination and omission, insufficient spatial grounding, and inference cost in generative OCR. We review evaluation from character and scene text recognition to parsing individual structural elements and full-page transcription, highlighting gaps in consistent output definitions, attribution of performance to individual components, and coverage of real capture conditions and visible content and structure. Finally, we summarize the challenges facing OCR and discuss directions for future research. We continuously track related work at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era.

AI.brief_summary: 这篇综述以「忠实转写」定义 OCR，梳理从专用模型到统一模型的发展，将当代系统分为五类，并比较其架构、数据与训练，重点讨论生成式 OCR 的幻觉与漏识、空间定位不足、推理成本及评测缺口。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「输出每个元素都须可由图像视觉证据验证」的判据、幻觉/漏识与空间定位诊断、以及性能归因问题，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容贡献分配的评测设计提供参照，可供核查。
